note: XXVII cues 97–98 from Ian's pick B1 (22 Nov 2:31 a.m.): the mark leaving in smoke rising only from it, and the same face clear.

beats.text: Add a single thin wisp of dense white smoke rising straight upward from the red cross-in-a-circle mark on her forehead, beginning exactly at the mark and curling up past her hairline into the sunset sky, as if the mark is burning away; the mark itself is fainter and paler where the smoke leaves it. No smoke anywhere else, none near her mouth or nose. Keep her face, expression, eyes, hair, scarf, light and background exactly as they are.

Remove the red mark from the young woman's forehead completely, so her forehead is perfectly clear, smooth, unmarked skin lit by the sunset. Keep her face, expression, eyes, hair, scarf, light and background exactly as they are.
